items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT for Ravens vs Bengals; Tyler Huntley expected to start again. Third straight miss with high ankle sprain.
items.why: Downgraded Saturday after limited practice; confirmed by multiple sources.
items.implication: Huntley start; elevated Ravens pass-catcher and rushing upside in favorable spot.
items.opportunity: Ravens WR/TE targets and any backup RB carries increase.

items.text: Rams optimistic Puka Nacua (calf, Q) will play vs Raiders. Felt better Saturday; 'as long as no setbacks, feel good about him available.'
items.why: Source confirmation of improving status post-Saturday.
items.implication: High-end WR1 if active; monitor warmups closely.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets if cleared; Adams already OUT boosts him further.

items.text: Breece Hall (quad, Q) unlikely to play vs Dolphins. May work out but hasn't been full participant; bit early after missing three games.
items.implication: Fade in DFS/season long; backup RB volume spike.
items.opportunity: Jets RB committee or handcuff elevated snaps/carries.

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) ruled OUT for Monday Night vs Cowboys.
items.implication: Targets redistribute to remaining Eagles pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Goedert, Brown, or other WRs.

items.text: Saquon Barkley (hamstring, Q) expected to play Monday vs Cowboys despite questionable tag.
items.why: ETR summary and Rapoport corroboration of expected return.
items.implication: RB1 usage if active; monitor Monday inactives.
items.opportunity: Full carries/routes in high-volume Eagles offense.

items.text: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) OUT alongside DeVonta Smith for Eagles Monday game.
items.opportunity: Elevated snap/route share for remaining receivers and Goedert.

items.text: Steelers RB Rico Dowdle (knee, Q) and S DeShon Elliott both active/up for Paris game vs Saints.
items.implication: RB involvement in early game; potential committee or lead.

items.text: 49ers activated WR Christian Kirk; expected to play/make debut amid Evans/Deebo OUTs.
items.implication: Immediate WR opportunity in thin 49ers group; CMC slot boost possible.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets; pairs with CMC usage expansion.

items.text: Packers activated RB Josh Jacobs from exempt; expected to play Sunday at Detroit.
items.implication: Lead back role return; volume after layoff.
items.opportunity: Primary carries/goal-line; monitor snap share post-absence.

items.text: Jonah Coleman will be the Broncos RB you wish you had by year end. Should be rostered in 100% of leagues; go fix that.
items.why: Pre-season call reaffirmed; activated and IN per reports.
items.implication: Waiver/roster priority for DEN RB depth/opportunity.

items.text: Lamar Jackson, Puka Nacua, Breece Hall statuses crucial to Sunday DFS main slate. Sneaky important scratches: Brian Robinson, Tyler Warren, Emeka Egbuka. Tempted by CMC more slot WR work amid 49ers WR outs.
items.why: Player-specific on key variables and opportunity from absences; rarely buys RB-as-WR but 49ers WR dire situation + Kaelon Black makes CMC slot tempting.
items.implication: Projections updated; pivot if statuses flip.
items.opportunity: CMC routes/targets expansion; beneficiaries from OUTs like Bijan if BRob out.

items.text: Zach Charbonnet OUT; Kenneth Walker benefits in Seahawks backfield vs Chiefs.
items.opportunity: Increased carries, snaps, goal-line for Walker.

items.text: Brian Robinson OUT (hamstring); Bijan Robinson full backfield opportunity vs 49ers.
items.implication: Bijan monopoly on ATL RB work.

items.text: Giants RB Cam Skattebo back in as the lead back.
Broncos CB Pat Surtain II (ankle) unlikely to play today; good chance back next week.
items.implication: Softer coverage for ARI pass-catchers (McBride, MHJ, Wilson).

items.text: Emeka Egbuka OUT (sneaky scratch); impacts TB WR depth with Mayfield returning.
items.implication: Targets to other Bucs WRs if Mayfield plays.

items.text: Loves A.J. Brown usage/matchup (WR10 range); also Tucker Kraft TE buffet vs DET; volume for Warren/Hubbard/Irving; Saquon if active.
items.implication: Strong start candidates; Kraft high TE upside.

items.text: Hates Rome Odunze (shadow), Josh Downs, Travis Kelce tough D, Josh Jacobs post-layoff workload risk.
items.why: Matchup shadows, tough defenses, layoff concerns.
items.implication: Fade or sit candidates despite name value.
items.conflict: Jacobs activated/expected but Berry wary of volume.
